newsitem.title: UK: GENERAL UTILITIES PURSUES LEIGH INTERESTS.
newsitem.headline: GENERAL UTILITIES PURSUES LEIGH INTERESTS.

text.p: Leigh Interests, the UK environmental services group, said on Monday it had received an "unsolicited approach" from General Utilities, the UK subsidiary of French water company General des Eaux.
The group confirmed that United had approached its chairman on Sunday, sending Leigh's shares soaring to touch a new year high of 154p.
"No proposal has yet been put forward by General Utilities and it is not clear to Leigh whether any proposal will be forthcoming," the group said in a statement.
Leigh, whose shares had settled back to be up 27.5p at 146.5p at 1315 GMT, promised to make a further statement when the situtation became clearer.
